newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil sets price/date of Santos terminal auction.
newsitem.headline: Brazil sets price/date of Santos terminal auction.

text.p: The privatisation auction of the container terminal at Brazil's key port of Santos will be held on September 17, with a minimum price of 101.184 million reais, Planning Minister Antonio Kandir said.
The sales document should be published by the end of July, he added after a meeting of the National Privatisation Council.
The winner of the auction must accept to reduce gradually the handling cost for each container over a three-year period according to a timetable agreed at today's meeting.
In the first six months of the concession, the maximum cost will be 500 reais, the second 330 reais, the third 253 reais, the fourth 195 reais and finally 150 reais in the last year, officials said.
After three years, the handling cost will be regulated by the market, they added.

The director of the Sao Paulo Docks Company (CODESP) said at the meeting that through a voluntary redundancy scheme the company expects the number its employees to fall to 1,000 by the end of the year from a current workforce of 5,400.
Local news agency Invest News also said the five ports in Rio de Janeiro state should be included in the privatisation process by the end of this year.
